title: Building Modern Websites with Next.js
content:
Next.js has become one of the most popular frameworks for building React applications, and for good reason. It provides an incredible developer experience while delivering fast, production-ready websites.

Why Next.js?

There are several reasons I chose Next.js for this site:

  • App Router — The new App Router provides a powerful file-based routing system with layouts, loading states, and error handling built in.
  • Server Components — React Server Components allow you to render on the server by default, sending less JavaScript to the client.
  • API Routes — Build your backend alongside your frontend in the same project.
  • Performance — Automatic code splitting, image optimization, and more.

The Stack

This site is built with a surprisingly simple stack:

  • Next.js 14 with App Router
  • Vanilla CSS with custom properties for theming
  • JSON files for blog post storage
  • TipTap for the rich text editor

Sometimes the simplest approach is the best approach. No database servers to manage, no complex deployment pipelines — just code and content.

The best technology is the one that gets out of your way and lets you focus on what matters: creating great content.
